parse.title: Pay-to-play Ranged training
parse.wikitext:
===Levels 70–99: Pest Control=== Participating at the [[Pest Control]] [[minigame]] and spending [[Void Knight commendation points]] on Ranged experience is an alternative training method at higher levels. Having a combat level of at least 100 for the veteran boat is recommended. Completion of the [[Easy Combat Achievements|easy]], [[Combat Achievements/Medium|medium]] and [[hard Combat Achievements]] increases the number of points earned per game.
